mappings.title: Red Owl
mappings.quantum_principle: Two particles become correlated. Measure one, instantly know the other.
mappings.operational_metaphor: In any complex system, variables are entangled. Change one element, and others shift.
mappings.key_question: What else moves when this moves?
mappings.warning: Entanglement is invisible until you test it. Probe, not assume.

mappings.title: Orange Orangutan
mappings.quantum_principle: A particle passes through a barrier it classically shouldn't be able to cross.
mappings.operational_metaphor: When the obvious path is blocked, there may still be a way through.
mappings.key_question: What's the smallest version that gets through?
mappings.warning: Tunneling is probabilistic. Some barriers are real. Know the difference.

mappings.title: Yellow Honeybee
mappings.quantum_principle: A particle exists in multiple states simultaneously until observed.
mappings.operational_metaphor: Hold multiple solutions at once. The act of building collapses superposition into reality.
mappings.key_question: What if we built three versions and let users collapse the wavefunction?
mappings.warning: Superposition requires resources. Balance breadth with burn rate.

mappings.title: Green Tortoise
mappings.quantum_principle: Quantum information transfers without crossing the intervening space.
mappings.operational_metaphor: Move knowledge and resources efficiently. Perfect handoffs. No wasted motion.
mappings.key_question: How do we move the insight without moving the whole team?
mappings.warning: Teleportation requires infrastructure. Build the receiving station before sending.

mappings.title: Blue Dolphin
mappings.quantum_principle: Light behaves as a wave or a particle depending on observation.
mappings.operational_metaphor: Communication has two modes: Broadcast (wave) or Precision (particle).
mappings.key_question: Is this a broadcast or a direct hit?
mappings.warning: Duality is not optional. You cannot be both at once. Commit to a mode per channel.

mappings.title: Purple Elephant
mappings.quantum_principle: A system that is observed frequently enough cannot evolve.
mappings.operational_metaphor: Feedback loops stabilize outcomes. Observation shapes what happens.
mappings.key_question: How often must we observe this to keep it true?

cycle_as_wavefunction.description: The full Council cycle can be understood as a single quantum event
steps: Red (Entanglement): Map the possibility space. Everything is connected.
Orange (Tunneling): Find viable paths through the constraints.
Green (Teleportation): Transfer resources to the most promising.
Blue (Duality): Communicate in the right mode to the right audience.
Purple (Zeno): Lock in the outcome with observation.
cycle_as_wavefunction.loop: Then the cycle restarts. The locked outcome becomes the new entangled state.
